confidence_notes: Food anchors rest on aggregated 2026 cost-of-living sources (MyLifeElsewhere, Where and When, combien-coute) rather than official surveys. The cocktail figure comes from 2021 Expatistan club data and was adjusted upward by judgement. The beer figure is a judgement from 2021 Expatistan pub data and older forum anecdotes. No local wine price was found, so wine_glass is inferred from beer using a local price relationship of about 2.75 times beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no live booking pages or current listings were inspected. FX: the latest RBA observation for 2026-10-16 could not be retrieved. The fx values are the most recent RBA figure surfaced by search (a search summary attributed 0.7088 USD per AUD to 2026-03-20 on the RBA exchange-rates page). I could not open the live RBA table to verify it, and the value is roughly seven months old, so it should be replaced by the latest RBA observation.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Estimates are anchored to Yogyakarta-specific sources and to typical pricing in mid-sized Indonesian tourist cities. Bali and Jakarta were treated as higher-priced and were not used as bases. Wine is derived from the beer anchor by the stated local price relationship.
